stories.title: London Stadium to increase concerts to cut losses
stories.summary: The Stratford venue can more than double the number of concerts it hosts each year.

stories.title: Teen couple jailed after attempting to buy a gun
stories.summary: Sofija Vinogradova and Rex Clark are jailed after discussing mass-shootings and trying to buy a gun.

stories.title: Council accuses Home Office over Palestine panel
stories.summary: Hackney's mayor says the Home Office put pressure on the council over a panel discussion about Palestine.

stories.title: Russell Brand prison message 'appalling' and being investigated, No 10 says
stories.summary: Brand's wife read out comments from the comedian on their podcast in which the convicted rapist said he was "not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for".

stories.title: Armed phone thief on e-bike tracked by drone jailed
stories.summary: Wesley Rodrigues, 18, was tracked as he sped through central London streets before being arrested.

stories.title: Fox rescued after wandering on to Tube tracks
stories.summary: Transport for London says it understands the fox was lured into a driver's cab and later freed.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson: How the Londoner became 007
stories.summary: The Twilight, Batman and Odyssey star's profile will go even more stellar when he plays James Bond.

stories.title: Witnesses sought after fatal shooting in front of crowd
stories.summary: Met Police detectives want to speak to people seen in CCTV footage as witnesses to the fatal shooting.

stories.title: Park cafe managers drop legal case over takeover
stories.summary: Independent cafes in Hampstead Heath, Queens Park and Highgate Woods are to be handed to a chain.

stories.title: What to do with your fridge if it needs dumping
stories.summary: In London, a number of councils are no longer accepting waste collections of fridges and freezers.

stories.title: How a broken London bridge has split a community
stories.summary: Redbridge Council says Broadmead Road Bridge cannot be fixed without government help.

stories.title: Tube strikes on track as pressure grows on mayor
stories.summary: Tube strikes on track for 26 November as MPs say mayor must do more to end four-day week row.
